servicesPage.metaDescription: THINKAD: OOH planning, media selection, and flight management. End-to-end outdoor advertising aligned with your goals.
servicesPage.heroTitle: An OOH partner built on data—and proven in the field
servicesPage.heroSubtitle: We design and execute nationwide media plans for your brand and budget, and manage performance throughout the campaign.
servicesPage.pillar1Body: Media strategy and creative direction grounded in audience, trade areas, and footfall—aligned with your KPIs.
servicesPage.pillar2Body: From selection and contracts through production, install, in-flight monitoring, and issue resolution—we run campaigns with a field-first mindset.
servicesPage.pillar3Body: We turn exposure, footfall, and performance signals into clear reporting and insights for the next flight—and for AI-assisted planning.
servicesPage.diff1: A verifiable network anchored in owned and partner landmark inventory
servicesPage.diff2: Transparent communication from briefing through post-campaign review
servicesPage.diff3: Media mixes and flight scenarios shaped by data plus on-the-ground experience
servicesPage.diff4: Planner tools and AI workflows that speed discovery and iteration
servicesPage.faq1Q: How do I get an OOH quote?
servicesPage.faq1A: Share region, timing, and budget—we’ll respond with mix direction and next steps. You can also add candidates from our media catalog and request a quote.
servicesPage.faq2Q: Is there a minimum flight or budget?
servicesPage.faq2A: Requirements vary by format and district. After a short brief, we outline feasible options and alternatives.
servicesPage.faq3Q: Do you cover both DOOH and classic OOH?
servicesPage.faq3A: Yes—billboards, media poles, transit, digital panels, and more, mixed to match your goals.
servicesPage.faq4A: We track schedules and on-site issues during the campaign and share interim or wrap-up reporting as needed.
servicesPage.processIntro: From briefing to post-campaign review, we guide you clearly at every step.
servicesPage.step1Body: Align on budget, timing, audience, geography, and must-win messages.
servicesPage.step2Body: Propose mix, flight scenarios, and estimated reach using data and field insight.
servicesPage.step3Body: Lock inventory, rates, and specs; align creative and legal requirements.
servicesPage.step4Body: Asset QA, scheduling, launch checks, and on-the-ground troubleshooting.
servicesPage.step5Body: In-flight checks and wrap-up insights for the next campaign.
servicesPage.ctaSubtitle: Share budget and timing—we’ll respond quickly with direction and next steps.
